fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole SUV (2010 Ford Explorer Limited) in the cars-by-owner section.
findings: Headlight lenses look slightly hazy and yellowed, most visible on the passenger side in the front three-quarter shot
Silver paint on the hood and sides looks a little flat rather than glossy
Dirt and road film along the lower rocker panels, running boards and rear bumper
Rear bumper step pad and black lower trim look faded and grayish
Seller mentions small paint chips on the hood, a candidate for touch-up though they aren't clearly visible in the photos
No interior photos, so the cabin can't be judged
message: Hi Carl, we saw your listing for the Explorer Limited. It looks well kept, but the headlights are starting to haze and the black trim on the rear bumper has faded a bit, which are quick fixes that help in photos. We do mobile pre-sale details, including headlight restoration and touch-up on small hood chips, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
